peak/off-peak rates."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Prices every finalized LLM call (`assistant/message` usage) against a

- Publishes a per-"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"session `cost` projection (total / peak / off-peak / per-model),

- Flags calls that land in a configured peak window.
- Models without a pri"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"cing entry are surfaced as "unconfigured" with a
placeholder, so you know to add them."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Install into a dsh profile straight from GitHub — the plugin ships a

`config` (see below). To"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" override defaults, add a `cost-tracker` row to the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` — later layers "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ults, add a `cost-tracker` row to the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` — later layers win by row id."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> ⚠️ When overriding, address the row by its **`id`** (`cost-tracker`), **not** by
> `name`. Cordis "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"non-insert patches locate the target line by `id`; a `name`-keyed
> override row is silently dropped"},{"id":"p11s3","text":", leaving prices at `models: {}`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The cross-session bill persists through dsh's storage domain; a profile

currency units per *"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"*million tokens**; you fill them in manually (no scraping)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Session projection"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The plugin registers the `cost` projection:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Cache writes are priced at the miss rate (providers bill the write at the miss
tier; the written tok"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ens become cache hits on a later call)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Billing correctness"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Two choices keep the numbers honest:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Cache writes are billed at the miss rate, not the hit rate.** Providers

session writes fresh context. Some cost plugins fold cache writes into the
h"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"it bucket; this plugin does not.
- **Unknown models are never silently priced.** A model with no pri"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"cing entry
is surfaced as "unconfigured" with a placeholder in the projection and UI,
so a guessed d"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"efault can't hide in your bill. You add the price, or you see
